title: Twelve merged OpenVibe tickets
description: The first AL8 gate suite: twelve small tickets from merged OpenVibe pull requests across Bench, Codes, AI, Actor, Exchange, Report and Network. Each goal is the merged change in words; each check is the pull request's own test, applied only after the worker stops. Base is the merge commit's parent, so the test fails before the change and passes after it.

tickets.goal: The shared navbar can open Messages in Dock Chats in place: the signed-in person's verified Network access token is available through a same-origin, no-store GET /auth/navbar-token route, while /auth/me stays token-free.

Two task runs through the coding agent's tool loop send the same model, system message and tool schemas, in a fixed order, so a provider caches one prompt prefix; only the user message differs between tasks.
The composer's "Who leads" choice names the person's own saved setting and is the option selected; a person who never chose is not pinned to Opus when the Settings page is saved untouched.

The space.app.build template accepts an optional components input (up to 20,000 characters) and, when present, puts it in the system prompt as the design.component@1 interface vocabulary with the rule that every major part carries data-ov-component; without it the prompt is exactly as before.

Two assemblies of the agent's system prompt with different dates and plans share the whole rules prefix byte for byte, and the tool definitions serialize identically, because today's date, the plan, the ledger and the demoted-tools note come after the rules.
The skills scan flags a URL to an undeclared host when a negation appears elsewhere in the sentence; a negation standing immediately before the URL (or one word before it) still passes it.

@@ -63,6 +63,13 @@ const RULES = [
         good: { instructions: 'Read https://other.example/page for the answer.', requires: { hosts: ['other.example'] } },
         state: 'flagged',
     },
+    {
+        // A negation elsewhere in the sentence does not hide the host it reaches.
+        rule: 'hosts.undeclared',
+        bad: { instructions: 'Do not wait: read https://other.example/page for the answer.' },
+        good: { instructions: 'Never open https://other.example/page, and answer from the notes.' },
+        state: 'flagged',
+    },
 ];

tickets.goal: The status board and a model's offer table show each offer's measured status, Up, Degraded when more than 5% of at least 10 requests in the last hour failed, or Down when the offer's circuit is open, with the plain status_reason and status_since that OpenVibe.AI sends in its catalog; Exchange infers nothing.

The owner console has owner-only JSON read endpoints for Providers, Models and the Pricebook, plus provider-settings and model-override form routes that forward audited changes to OpenVibe.AI; provider key values never appear in console data, and the existing owner and same-origin checks stay.

Report announces its tables as an open dataset through Dataset JSON-LD on / and /stats, built with the shared seo.jsonLd.dataset builder: name, description, creator OpenVibe, keywords and a distribution list pointing at /api/v1/stats, /api/v1/ai/results and /api/v1/rundown/topics.
A display preference save keeps motion: full and motion: off as well as auto and reduced, reads each of the four back from the active theme, and still drops an unknown value.
openvibe.link's Send widget reads /auth/me before it asks for send keys, so a signed-out visitor sees its existing sign-in line with no 401 from /api/v1/me/nodes/send-keys.

tickets.goal: The frame wallet relay takes the person's ov_token cookie when no Bearer token is sent, forwards it upstream as the Bearer and never as a cookie, and only an origin already on the CORS allow-list (or no Origin) may use that path.
